mentions.name: Ryelang
mentions.description: Ryelang is a programming language. Recent work covers language core, the console, and generic methods, plus updated integrations with OpenAI, IMAP, and Surf (a browser-like client). The author also experiments by combining these libraries, e.g. scripts that fetch unread work emails via IMAP and summarize the most important and most urgent ones through the OpenAI API, tried the libraries interactively in a terminal session, and built a console applet.
mentions.source_excerpt:
When I am not working on my 'job' project, I am working on Ryelang.

In September, I was working on language core, console, generic methods, etc ... but this week I updated integration with OpenAI, IMAP, Surf (browser like client) and then I did few experiments by meshing together these libs.
